titolo: OpenAI highlights ChatGPT and Codex boosting engineering workflows
descr: OpenAI reports its AI tools are speeding up CAD, PCB design, simulation and related physical‑world tasks.
paragrafi: OpenAI released a statement on 2026-11-03 describing how its models are being used in engineering.
The company says ChatGPT and Codex help engineers accelerate computer‑aided design, printed‑circuit‑board design and simulation.
These tools are positioned to improve productivity across physical‑world workflows.
OpenAI frames the development as part of its broader effort to support engineering tasks with AI.
perche: For engineers, the claim suggests faster design cycles and reduced manual effort. For users of free or local models, it signals a benchmark for capabilities that open‑source alternatives may aim to match.
